body:
I drank Poweraid before going to a rave after taking ecstacy; I feel that the poweraid doesent quench my thirst as well as water did.  I prefered the pure taste of water rather than the thicker, richer taste of poweraid.  I have no idea how my body chemistry was affected by the poweraid but I found that at times I would crave water and I felt like trashing the poweraid.  I felt an anger towards it, almost like I 'hated' poweraid.  :)
